mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.card_id,e.attempt_id,e.attempt_sequence,e.sequence_number AS event_sequence, e.attempt_revision,e.count_regular,e.rate_basis_kind AS basis_kind,e.occurred_at,e.snapshot_json AS event_json, a.id AS stored_attempt_id,a.card_version_id,a.sequence_number AS stored_attempt_sequence, a.revision AS stored_attempt_revision,a.state,a.mode,a.count_regular AS stored_count_regular, a.cram_batch_id,a.start_snapshot_json AS start_json,a.started_at,a.revealed_at,a.rated_at,a.closed_at, a.rating,a.last_event_sequence, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_source fixed_source JOIN knowledge_version referenced ON referenced.owner_id=fixed_source.owner_id AND referenced.item_id=fixed_source.knowledge_item_id AND referenced.id=fixed_source.knowledge_version_id JOIN knowledge_revalidation_impact upstream ON upstream.owner_id=referenced.owner_id AND upstream.target_item_id=referenced.item_id JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=upstream.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=upstream.target_item_id AND adopted.id=upstream.target_version_id WHERE fixed_source.owner_id=a.owner_id AND fixed_source.card_id=a.card_id AND fixed_source.version_id=a.card_version_id AND adopted.version_number <= referenced.version_number AND upstream.created_at > e.occurred_at) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_source fixed_source JOIN knowledge_version referenced ON referenced.owner_id=fixed_source.owner_id AND referenced.item_id=fixed_source.knowledge_item_id AND referenced.id=fixed_source.knowledge_version_id JOIN preparation_knowledge_impact upstream ON upstream.owner_id=referenced.owner_id AND upstream.target_item_id=referenced.item_id JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=upstream.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=upstream.target_item_id AND adopted.id=upstream.target_version_id WHERE fixed_source.owner_id=a.owner_id AND fixed_source.card_id=a.card_id AND fixed_source.version_id=a.card_version_id AND adopted.version_number <= referenced.version_number AND upstream.created_at > e.occurred_at)) AS upstream_changed FROM memory_attempt_event e LEFT JOIN memory_recall_attempt a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.card_id=e.card_id AND a.id=e.attempt_id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.event_kind='RATE' AND e.id IN

SELECT v.id,v.card_id,v.version_number,v.card_kind AS kind,v.title,v.source_count,v.related_concept_count, p.id AS current_version_id, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE v.card_kind<>p.card_kind OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.prompt_json,'$.prompt')) AS BINARY) <>CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.prompt_json,'$.prompt')) AS BINARY) OR CAST(v.reference_text AS BINARY)<>CAST(p.reference_text AS BINARY) OR v.source_count<>p.source_count OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_source s WHERE s.owner_id=v.owner_id AND s.card_id=v.card_id AND s.version_id=v.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_source n WHERE n.owner_id=p.owner_id AND n.card_id=p.card_id AND n.version_id=p.id AND n.knowledge_item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND n.knowledge_version_id=s.knowledge_version_id)) END AS basis_changed FROM memory_card_version v LEFT JOIN memory_card c ON c.owner_id=v.owner_id AND c.id=v.card_id LEFT JOIN memory_card_version p ON p.owner_id=c.owner_id AND p.card_id=c.id AND p.id=c.current_version_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.id IN

SELECT s.version_id AS card_version_id,s.knowledge_item_id AS item_id,s.knowledge_version_id AS version_id, k.kind,v.version_number,k.status,k.current_version_id, CASE WHEN v.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(v.body AS BINARY)<>CAST(p.body AS BINARY) END AS body_changed, s.position_index, AS upstream_review_required FROM memory_card_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.id=s.knowledge_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND v.id=s.knowledge_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version p ON p.owner_id=k.owner_id AND p.item_id=k.id AND p.id=k.current_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.version_id IN ORDER BY s.version_id,s.position_index

SELECT v.id FROM memory_card_version v WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.id IN AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_source s JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.id=s.knowledge_item_id JOIN knowledge_item_topic l ON l.item_id=k.id JOIN knowledge_topic t ON t.owner_id=k.owner_id AND t.id=l.topic_id WHERE s.owner_id=v.owner_id AND s.card_id=v.card_id AND s.version_id=v.id AND t.id=#{topicId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_card_concept c JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=c.owner_id AND k.id=c.concept_id JOIN knowledge_item_topic l ON l.item_id=k.id JOIN knowledge_topic t ON t.owner_id=k.owner_id AND t.id=l.topic_id WHERE c.owner_id=v.owner_id AND c.card_id=v.card_id AND c.version_id=v.id AND t.id=#{topicId}))
